title: Midnight Street Chef
premise: A neon-styled street-food arcade game where the player runs a skewer stall, taps to cook inventory, and automatically serves passing customers for cash.
interaction_model: Single-button/tap cooking with automatic customer purchasing, continuous real-time play, and HUD-based score tracking.
objective: Build food stock fast enough to satisfy incoming customers and maximize cash, especially during the night-time price bonus.
progression: Endless score-chasing progression driven by random customer flow, a looping day-night cycle, and rising pressure to keep stock available rather than by explicit levels or upgrades.
theme: Night market street-food hustle with a cheerful arcade presentation.
mood: Warm, lively, neon, casual, and slightly hectic in a playful way.
likely_audience: Casual mobile players, arcade fans, and players who enjoy simple tap-driven management loops.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the core loop is tap-to-cook, stock management, and auto-selling to customers.
High confidence that the day-night cycle materially affects pricing through a x2 night bonus.
Moderate confidence that the game is intended as endless arcade score attack rather than structured stage progression.
Low confidence on any deeper long-term systems because no upgrades, failure screen, or meta-progression are present in the code.
recreation_prompt: Create a casual mobile-first arcade cooking game called "Midnight Street Chef" set at a colorful neon night market. The player runs a small skewer stall viewed from the front, with a large central button used to tap and cook food. Each tap fills a cooking meter, and when the meter completes it produces one unit of food stock that appears on the stall counter. Customers should automatically arrive from the left, walk up to the stall, queue briefly, and buy food automatically if stock is available; if they wait too long with no stock, they should leave with a negative reaction. Track cash as the main score and show stock and time on a simple HUD. Include a looping day-to-night cycle that changes the background from sunset tones to a starry night scene, and during night time activate a visible 2x bonus so each sale is worth double. Present the game with bright gradients, a cozy street-stall backdrop, a chef character behind the counter, floating reward text, steam and coin particles, upbeat sound feedback, and quick reaction animations. Keep the gameplay endless, readable, touch-friendly, and centered on the rhythm of tapping to produce inventory fast enough to satisfy customer demand and maximize earnings.
